entities.name: EPS QoS
entities.description: Quality of Service parameters for an EPS bearer context, defining the bearer's performance characteristics.

entities.name: EPS bearer context
entities.description: The context storing the state and parameters of an EPS bearer, including its QoS profile.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity responsible for modifying and assigning EPS QoS parameters to EPS bearer contexts.

relations.description: The network assigns the modified EPS QoS to the EPS bearer context when the QoS is modified.
The EPS bearer context contains the EPS QoS information element defining its quality of service parameters.
